title.zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
title.en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT

current_state.zh: Tether 短暂黑名单并冻结 THORChain 四个 USDT 金库地址约 145 万 USDT，导致交易暂停；数小时后地址被解冻，交易恢复，双方未解释原因。
current_state.en: Tether briefly blacklisted and froze four THORChain USDT vault addresses holding about 1.45 million USDT, pausing trading; the addresses were unfrozen hours later, trading resumed, and neither side explained the action.

updates.title_zh: Tether 将 145 万枚 USDT 列入黑名单三小时后，解冻四个 THORChain 金库
updates.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
updates.what_changed_zh: Tether 将四个持有 145 万 USDT 的 THORChain 金库列入黑名单，促使 THORChain 在未事先通知的情况下暂停 Tron 兑换和流动性提供者操作。
updates.what_changed_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.
updates.current_state_zh: Tether 将四个持有 145 万 USDT 的 THORChain 金库列入黑名单，促使 THORChain 在未事先通知的情况下暂停 Tron 兑换和流动性提供者操作。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.
updates.background_zh: 据 Valken 介绍，Tether 的黑名单在智能合约层面通过只有 Tether 可调用的 addBlackList 函数执行，该发行方已冻结逾 44 亿美元、涉及 1200 多个地址的 USDT。THORChain 通过原生金库而非桥接合约结算 Tron 资产。本周早些时候，跨境支付平台 Conduit Technology 起诉 Tether，指其冻结了一个与巴西当局 2024 年调查相关钱包中价值 276 万美元的 USDT；两名泰国公民也在 8 月起诉 Tether，称其在美国国土安全调查局（HSI）的「非正式请求」下冻结了 4240 万美元的 USDT。
updates.background_en: Tether's blacklist is enforced at the smart contract level through an addBlackList function that only Tether can call, and the issuer has frozen over $4.4 billion in USDT across more than 1,200 addresses, according to Valken. THORChain settles Tron assets through native vaults rather than bridge contracts. Earlier this week, cross-border payments platform Conduit Technology sued Tether, alleging it froze $2.76 million in USDT in a wallet tied to a 2024 investigation by Brazilian authorities, and two Thai nationals sued in August over an alleged freeze of $42.4 million following an "informal request" from US Homeland Security Investigations.
updates.market_impact_zh: THORChain 的 Tron 金库持有原生 USDT-TRC20，不经桥接合约结算，因此发行方层面的冻结会在解除前直接阻断该板块的兑换、充值与签名，表明 Tether 发行的流动性带有发行方可控的「开关」。该事件使依赖 Tron 上 USDT 的 DeFi 协议与交易场所继续承受审查风险，也波及通过 RUNE 暴露于 THORChain 跨链流动性的市场参与者。
updates.market_impact_en: THORChain's Tron vaults hold native USDT-TRC20 settled without bridge contracts, so an issuer-level freeze directly blocks swaps, deposits and signing for that segment until it is reversed, showing that Tether-issued liquidity carries an issuer-controlled kill switch. The episode leaves a censorship-risk overhang on DeFi protocols and venues that depend on USDT on Tron, and on RUNE exposure to THORChain's cross-chain liquidity.
